title: Frozen operating scenario v2: independently versioned operating-scenario choices (A9.24 item 4); constraint-derived inputs are value-free references to the engineering constraints by id
authored: FROZEN_ARTEFACT_NOT_GENERATED: written once (A9.24 item 4) and pinned by id + scenario_version + sha256 in abep_sim/configuration.py OPERATING_SCENARIO_PIN; scripts/config/build_config.py only verifies it against that pin and lists it in config/MANIFEST.json; it never regenerates it and never derives a value from the engineering constraints or the requirements snapshot

supersedes.reason: v1 was regenerated from the engineering constraints on every build (set_equal_to_constraint)

engineering_constraints.note: no sha256 pin of the constraints file (A9.24 item 4: changing a compliance threshold alone must not invalidate or change this scenario); the constraints file itself stays sha256-checked against config/MANIFEST.json

rule: abep_sim/operating_inputs.py (physics seam) reads this file through abep_sim.configuration.load_operating_inputs (fail closed: the config/MANIFEST.json sha256 AND the code-side pin OPERATING_SCENARIO_PIN must match). Inputs of kind OPERATING_SCENARIO_CHOICE are explicit frozen engineering choices consumed by physics; their initial_basis names the engineering constraint they were first set equal to (provenance only, never re-read). Changing a compliance threshold alone may change the assessment and must not change raw physics; changing a choice here may change raw physics and requires a new scenario file, id and scenario_version (A9.24 item 4). Inputs of kind CONSTRAINT_REFERENCE carry no value (single source: engineering_constraints_v1).
